headline: ハンタウイルスは棘の中央の穴で受容体を捉える
subhead: アンデスウイルスのスパイクとPCDH1の複合体を2.6 Åのクライオ電顕で解いた
target_en: Andes virus (ANDV) Gn–Gc spike with human PCDH1

summary.question: 新世界ハンタウイルスは受容体 PCDH1 で細胞に入るが、その結合の構造的な仕組みは分かっていなかった。
summary.approach: 可溶性のスパイク四量体を PCDH1 と共発現して精製し、クライオ電顕で解いた。変異体と深部変異スキャンで結合部位を調べた。
summary.result: PCDH1 の EC1 ドメインは、Gn 四分子がつくる中央の深い窪みに入り込んでいた。窪みは Fab が入るには狭かった。
summary.learned: PCDH1 はウイルス粒子の上のスパイクだけを認識する。抗体は窪みをふさぐか、かさ高さで受容体の接近を妨げて中和する。

question.quote: New World hantaviruses, including Andes virus (ANDV), use the cell-surface receptor protocadherin-1 (PCDH1) to enter host cells1. However, the structural basis of this interaction remains unclear.

approach.quote: we designed a soluble version of the ANDV spike tetramer by adding a hetero-octamerization domain at the C-terminal end of the Gn and Gc ectodomains
Next, we used a deep-mutational scanning (DMS) approach to more comprehensively survey the sequence landscape of the spike–PCDH1 interaction.
approach.section: PCDH1 binds to a central spike pocket

result.quote: The final model showed the EC1 domain deeply inserted into a pocket formed by four protomers of Gn
result.section: PCDH1 binds to a central spike pocket

result.quote: are incompatible with those of a Fab fragment (5 × 4 × 7 nm).

learned.quote: PCDH1 asymmetrically engages a deep central pocket formed by four Gn protomers in the spike, explaining why only intact viral particles or soluble tetramers recognize it.
they block receptor binding through two distinct mechanisms—occluding access to the PCDH1-binding site or sterically preventing receptor engagement.

highlights.text: 1個の受容体が4個のウイルス糖タンパク質と接する結合様式で、論文は、著者の知る限り他の外被ウイルスで見られていないとしている。EC1 は隣り合う2つの Gn と主に接触する。

evidence.quote: This mode of interaction, whereby one receptor molecule interacts with four viral glycoproteins, represents a binding mode that to our knowledge has not been observed in any enveloped virus
evidence.section: PCDH1 binds to a central spike pocket

highlights.text: Gn の3つのループが結合部位をつくる。旧世界ハンタウイルス HTNV のスパイクにこの3ループを移すと、PCDH1 に弱く結合するようになった。

evidence.quote: Mutagenesis identified three Gn loops that shape the receptor-binding site and afford the transfer of PCDH1 binding from New World to Old World glycoproteins.
a chimeric rVSV-HTNV bearing all three receptor-binding loops from ANDV Gn, but not the GnH CD loop alone, could now bind to PCDH1, albeit relatively weakly.

highlights.text: 中和抗体4種のうち、ANDV-5 と MIB22 は窪みを直接ふさぐ。ADI-65534 と ANDV-34 は窪みに入らず、IgG の定常領域による立体障害で競合すると考えられる。MIB22 と GnH の複合体は X 線で 3.1 Å に解かれた。

evidence.quote: We observed that ADI-65534 and ANDV-34 do not occlude access to the central pocket, suggesting that they compete with PCDH1 through a steric hindrance mechanism mediated by the antibody constant regions
We therefore determined the crystal structure of an antibody fragment of MIB22 in a complex with ANDV GnH at a resolution of 3.1 Å

lab_notes.expression: ショウジョウバエ S2 細胞で安定発現し、CdCl2 で誘導。
lab_notes.construct: Gn・Gc の細胞外領域に人工の四量体化ドメイン HALC4_136 を分割して融合。
lab_notes.purification: Strep-Tactin 親和、TALON、Superose6 のゲル濾過の順。
lab_notes.sample_prep: 0.34 mg/ml を UltrAufoil グリッドに 3 μl のせ、Vitrobot Mark IV で凍結。
lab_notes.data_collection: Titan Krios と Falcon 4i、ピクセルサイズ 0.7455 Å。

evidence.quote: The octamerization sequence was derived from HALC4_136, a de novo tetramerization domain comprising three antiparallel helices per protomer20.

Cultures of 1–3 l were grown in spinner flasks in medium supplemented with 1% penicillin–streptomycin antibiotics to approximately 107 cells per ml, and protein expression was induced with 4 μM CdCl2.
Proteins were then purified by size-exclusion chromatography (SEC) on a 10/300 Superose6 Increase column (Cytiva) in 10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 100 mM NaCl.
Frozen grids were imaged on the Titan Krios POLARIS (Synchrotron Soleil) system equipped with a FALCON 4i detector (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
evidence.section: Cryo-EM grid preparation and data collection

keywords: 糖タンパク質スパイク
